owner_outcome.statement: Complete prerequisite designs 1-5 — the Goal A execution runbook, the machine-readable A1-A11 plus A5b cell graph, the five-state common lifecycle, the Codex/Claude/Gemini adapter contract, and a fresh maker-separated Design Flow v2 gate — then advance the frozen Goal A order from A1, proceeding without stopping except for destructive operations or infinite loops, which stop immediately.
owner_outcome.success_boundary: This pack closes when the three committed artifacts validate, the independent gate passes with P0 and P1 at zero, and the candidate receipt is published on issue 307. Non-goals: no A1 implementation, no runtime or fleet change, no merge or deploy, no redefinition of frozen roadmap decisions.

sources.authority_limit: Frozen Goal A roadmap body; the only advancement order and cell definitions; changes only via amendment comments.
Authorizes prerequisite design 1-5 plus an independent gate, then A1; authorizes zero protected effects and zero implementation now.
Binds maker arc, three allowed paths, exact baseline f7fcd0f1, validators, generation limit 1 plus 1 corrective.
Adds A5b (interim fleet deployment) after A5, its frozen steps, machine-checkable DoD, and the conditional owner gate on schema migration.
Canonical function vocabulary and gate semantics; this pack introduces no new functions.
Registered seat/function bindings; maker arc and reserved checker qa are bound identities.
The prerequisite-1 runbook authored in this same commit; the pack binds its exact digest.
The prerequisite-2 machine-readable cell graph authored in this same commit; the pack binds its exact digest.

inventing new Shirube functions or governance vocabulary

assumptions.statement: The frozen issue body plus its citable amendments are the sole semantic source for cell content; per-cell implementation detail lives in the referenced issues and is bound at each cell's own handoff time.
qa remains the reserved maker-history-external checker; if qa is unavailable another registered evidence_audit_gate seat outside the maker history may be bound by the orchestrator.

unknowns.statement: Whether the A5b 187-commit delta contains a DB schema migration is unknown until the machine enumeration in A5b step 1 runs; the conditional owner gate covers both outcomes.

inventions.statement: A five-state lifecycle with per-state entry and exit predicates as the single advancement semantics for all 12 cells.
inventions.rationale: The handoff freezes the state names; this pack adds the machine predicates so that EFFECT_PROVEN and CLOSED are measured, never asserted.

inventions.statement: The citation contract (authority requires URL plus raw sha256; missing either is typed-rejected) as a lifecycle-level invariant.
inventions.rationale: Issue 307 names the missing citation contract as design hole C2 and the root of the 2026-08-16 315-tick no-progress incident; the runbook closes it as an enforceable predicate (GA-07).

state_and_event_model.idempotency: one transition per cell id plus state plus evidence digest; duplicates admit zero effects
state_and_event_model.concurrency: one ACTIVATED work stream per cell; later cells may pre-build only
state_and_event_model.transaction: a transition records its evidence digest and the new state atomically; a failed evidence write leaves the prior state
state_and_event_model.consistency: the graph file plus issue 307 comments are the durable record; session memory and queue state are never authoritative

decisions.note: subject = frozen issue 307 body digest; author mode; exact baseline f7fcd0f1; three allowed paths only
graph and runbook are the two committed structure artifacts, digest-bound into this pack
10 predicates map 1:1 to fixtures and edges; evidence identity is URL plus sha256
citation contract closes design hole C2; owner gates enumerated
delivery handoff complete and implementation-inactive until gate pass plus per-cell handoffs
terminal admission is machine-measured; A5b nonterminal; halt and destructive stops are immediate

acceptance_predicates.predicate: the committed cell graph file re-hashes to sha256:fadaed5788ee75944b5e686524c954e0ce674815e1f743d5e99a1b23b1f69535 and contains exact_order equal to the 12-element array A1,A2,A3,A4,A5,A5b,A6,A7,A8,A9,A10,A11 with every cell carrying id, control_sources, depends_on, and effect_predicate
acceptance_predicates.evidence_producer: graph checker script over the committed graph file
acceptance_predicates.pass_rule: checker exits 0: digest equals the recorded digest, exact_order equals the frozen array, and zero cells miss a required field
acceptance_predicates.fail_rule: digest differs, order differs, or any cell misses a required field

acceptance_predicates.predicate: A5b is recorded nonterminal: the graph contains terminal_substitution_forbidden equals true for A5b, A5b sits between A5 and A6 in exact_order, and a fixture asserting A5b CLOSED leaves A1 state unchanged
acceptance_predicates.evidence_producer: graph checker plus lifecycle fixture for the A5b substitution attempt
acceptance_predicates.pass_rule: the A5b-substitution fixture returns typed ORDER_VIOLATION and A1 state reads back unchanged
acceptance_predicates.fail_rule: A5b CLOSED admits any A1 transition or the graph misses the nonterminal marker

acceptance_predicates.predicate: the runbook defines an entry predicate and an exit predicate for every lifecycle state; the count of states with both predicates equals 5 for BUILT, PLACED, ACTIVATED, EFFECT_PROVEN, CLOSED
acceptance_predicates.evidence_producer: lifecycle table checker over the committed runbook
acceptance_predicates.pass_rule: checker reads the lifecycle table and measures 5 states each with entry and exit predicates present
acceptance_predicates.fail_rule: any state misses an entry or exit predicate

acceptance_predicates.predicate: state-skip, reverse, and adapter-state transitions are rejected: fixtures for skip, reverse, and AUN-ack-driven transitions each return a typed reason code with cell state unchanged
acceptance_predicates.evidence_producer: lifecycle transition validator over invalid-transition fixtures
acceptance_predicates.pass_rule: all three invalid-transition fixtures return typed reject and readback shows state unchanged
acceptance_predicates.fail_rule: any invalid transition mutates state or returns without a typed reason

acceptance_predicates.predicate: the Codex, Claude, and Gemini adapter records carry the identical semantic core digest and zero adapter redefines state, authority, gate, reason-code, or evidence semantics
acceptance_predicates.evidence_producer: adapter contract checker over the three adapter records
acceptance_predicates.pass_rule: all three adapter semantic digests equal the core digest and the redefinition scan measures zero findings
acceptance_predicates.fail_rule: any adapter digest differs or a redefinition is detected

acceptance_predicates.predicate: an AUN queue close, ACK, or done event over a transported work item leaves the cell lifecycle state unchanged and terminal admission still requires the effect predicate
acceptance_predicates.evidence_producer: AUN boundary fixture replaying ack and done events against a PLACED cell
acceptance_predicates.pass_rule: after replaying ack and done the cell state reads back PLACED and terminal admission returns nonterminal with typed missing evidence
acceptance_predicates.fail_rule: any AUN event advances lifecycle state or reaches a terminal

acceptance_predicates.predicate: an authority citation that misses the URL or the raw sha256 is rejected with typed reason CITATION_UNCITABLE and zero effects; a citation with both fields whose readback re-hash equals the recorded sha256 is accepted
acceptance_predicates.evidence_producer: citation contract validator over four fixtures: missing url, missing hash, hash mismatch, valid
acceptance_predicates.pass_rule: fixture 1, fixture 2, and fixture 3 each return CITATION_UNCITABLE with zero effects and fixture 4 is accepted
acceptance_predicates.fail_rule: any citation missing the url or sha256 fields is accepted, or the citation whose readback digest matches is rejected

acceptance_predicates.predicate: owner-gate cells A6, A7, and A10 cannot leave PLACED without a cited fresh owner decision: the fixture without a citation returns typed OWNER_GATE_REQUIRED and the fixture with a citation that re-hashes equal advances
acceptance_predicates.evidence_producer: owner-gate fixture pair per gated cell
acceptance_predicates.pass_rule: all uncited gate fixtures return OWNER_GATE_REQUIRED with state unchanged and all cited fixtures advance
acceptance_predicates.fail_rule: any gated cell advances with zero owner decisions cited

acceptance_predicates.predicate: three consecutive no-progress evaluations for one cell halt the loop: the fixture measures halt_at_evaluation less than or equal to 3, notification_count equals 1, and artifact_count after halt equals 0
acceptance_predicates.evidence_producer: no-progress halt fixture replaying a blocked cell
acceptance_predicates.pass_rule: the fixture measures halt at or before evaluation 3 with exactly 1 notification and 0 artifacts afterward
acceptance_predicates.fail_rule: the loop exceeds 3 evaluations, emits more than 1 notification, or artifact_count after halt is nonzero

acceptance_predicates.predicate: every transition evidence record re-derives on readback: the fixture re-hashes each recorded artifact and a mismatch blocks the transition with typed reason EVIDENCE_NOT_REDERIVABLE
acceptance_predicates.evidence_producer: evidence identity fixture with one intact and one mutated evidence record
acceptance_predicates.pass_rule: the unchanged entry re-hashes equal and passes; the mutated entry returns EVIDENCE_NOT_REDERIVABLE and blocks
acceptance_predicates.fail_rule: a mutated evidence digest passes readback or an unchanged digest blocks

failure_threat_recovery.cause: a cell's work appears to require delete, reset, force-kill, fleet restart, schema migration, or secret access
failure_threat_recovery.protected_invariant: owner verbatim: destructive operations stop immediately
failure_threat_recovery.detection: the operation class matches the frozen forbidden list before execution
failure_threat_recovery.containment: typed immediate stop published once to issue 307 with current position and resume condition
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: owner decides; work resumes only under a cited fresh decision
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: novel destructive classes outside the list; mitigated by fail-closed classification

failure_threat_recovery.cause: a cell loop repeats the same evaluation without state change
failure_threat_recovery.protected_invariant: owner verbatim: loops stop immediately; halt bound 3 (GA-09)
failure_threat_recovery.detection: consecutive no-progress counter over distinct evidence digests reaches 3
failure_threat_recovery.containment: typed halt with exactly one escalation and zero further artifacts
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: authorized resume after the blocker clears
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: flapping progress signals; mitigated by counting distinct evidence digests only

failure_threat_recovery.cause: an authority is cited by prose or bare URL without a raw sha256
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: a decision exists locally or in memory but not as a citable comment
failure_threat_recovery.protected_invariant: citation contract (GA-07): URL plus sha256 or the citation is void
failure_threat_recovery.containment: the citing transition blocks with zero effects
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: publish the decision to the control source, then cite it with both fields
failure_threat_recovery.rollback: none; nothing advanced on the void citation
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: a published comment later edited; mitigated because the recorded sha256 no longer matches on readback

failure_threat_recovery.cause: an owner-gate cell attempts to advance on momentum or delegated claim
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: schedule pressure or a non-owner approval mistaken for authority
failure_threat_recovery.protected_invariant: A6/A7/A10 advance only on a cited fresh owner decision (GA-08)
failure_threat_recovery.detection: gate check finds no citable owner decision for the exact cell
failure_threat_recovery.containment: typed OWNER_GATE_REQUIRED block with state unchanged
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: request the decision once, then wait halted
failure_threat_recovery.rollback: none; the gate blocked before any effect
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: a real but stale decision reused; mitigated by freshness binding in the citation

failure_threat_recovery.cause: one adapter starts translating semantics instead of transport
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: adapter change lands without symmetry re-verification
failure_threat_recovery.detection: adapter symmetry check finds digest or semantics divergence
failure_threat_recovery.containment: the diverging adapter is non-authoritative; its transitions block
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: restore transport-only translation and re-verify symmetry
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: drift in surfaces without fixtures; mitigated by a fixture per adapter capability

failure_threat_recovery.cause: AUN queue close, ACK, or done is treated as cell completion
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: operator or executor reads adapter state as progress
failure_threat_recovery.detection: lifecycle validator rejects adapter-state transitions with a typed reason
failure_threat_recovery.containment: cell state unchanged; the event is recorded as transport evidence only
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: the effect predicate must be measured for real advancement
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: human reporting may still cite ACKs; reports without effect evidence carry no authority

failure_threat_recovery.cause: a transition evidence artifact becomes unreadable or mutated
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: storage loss or edit after recording
failure_threat_recovery.detection: readback re-hash differs from the recorded digest
failure_threat_recovery.containment: the dependent transition blocks with EVIDENCE_NOT_REDERIVABLE
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: re-derive from the source artifact or re-produce the evidence
failure_threat_recovery.rollback: revert the dependent state until evidence re-derives
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: simultaneous source loss; mitigated by publishing evidence to issue 307

failure_threat_recovery.cause: a later cell starts before an earlier cell closes, including A5b substituting A1
failure_threat_recovery.trigger: parallel enthusiasm or misread of the amendment
failure_threat_recovery.protected_invariant: exact_order is the only advancement order; A5b is nonterminal (GA-01, GA-02)
failure_threat_recovery.detection: order checker finds an open predecessor for the starting cell
failure_threat_recovery.containment: typed ORDER_VIOLATION block with zero effects
failure_threat_recovery.recovery: close the predecessor or obtain a cited owner waiver
failure_threat_recovery.rollback: none; the violating start was blocked
failure_threat_recovery.residual_risk: waivers accumulating; each waiver requires its own citable decision

operations_migration_rollback.operation: the runbook and graph are docs-only artifacts versioned in git; validators ship under later cell handoffs pinned to this pack digest

operations_migration_rollback.rollback: reverting the design branch restores the prior docs state; no runtime effect exists to roll back
